title: Crafting The Uncraftable
description: Be Able To Craft Uncraftabe Items.
body:
# Craft The Uncraftable

In Minecraft SMP people always want to craft itmes that are super rare or are only found in late game.

Thats Why i created **Craft The Uncraftable** 

Because getting lost or dying while trying to find these items take to much time

# What Did we Add??

- Shulkers
- Saddles
- Elytra
- Cobwebs

Will Be more in future versions
